scope: South Africa medical discovery — Stellenbosch University Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: Stellenbosch offers a six-year MBChB and publishes 2026/27 international application dates of 1 April–31 July 2026.
Its published international-curricula requirements prioritise South African citizens, permanent residents and refugees/asylum seekers in South Africa.
The programme specifies two years of internship and one year of community service before independent-practitioner eligibility with HPCSA.

holdReasons: No current MBChB international tuition amount or complete fee breakdown was found.
Published preference rules make a general international route uncertain; no current source defines availability for ordinary foreign applicants.
Independent current programme accreditation evidence and complete programme-specific clinical/accommodation content were not established.
nextAction: Obtain a written 2027-intake availability and fee statement for non-resident international applicants, plus current accreditation evidence, before any payload.
